Thesis.proseOnly: Opening case carries the bandwidth-vs-FLOPs decision; the mechanisms get figures in their own sections.

The Infrastructure Walls.proseOnly: The three walls are framed with numbers that each get a figure downstream (intensity growth → ridge-map, TDP → power-ladder, MTBF → node-mtbf eq).

The Accelerator and the Nameplate.proseOnly: Reticle/chiplet and precision-dial claims are carried by the precision-fit chart and the physics table.

The Memory Wall.teaches: The roofline landscape: ridge at ~295 FLOP/B, decode batch-1 at 1 FLOP/B (~0.34% of peak), prefill and training above the ridge. Whether the nameplate is reachable is decided before any tuning.
The Memory Wall.source: Roofline model + the chapter's landscape points (decode b1/b32, CNN, prefill-512, training).

Sustained Compute and Precision.proseOnly: The 1,000→2,500 GPU-hour correction is the sustained-hours equation's worked example.

The Node.teaches: Four tiers, three ~7-9× drops: parallelism choices map onto the staircase (TP inside NVLink, PP across nodes, DP across the fabric).
The Node.source: HBM3 3.35 TB/s → NVLink 900 GB/s → IB NDR 50 GB/s → storage 7 GB/s.

The Rack.teaches: Power compounds up the hierarchy: 700 W device → ~10 kW node → 33.5 kW rack → ~8 MW pod, with heat flux (~86 W/cm²) forcing liquid at the top.
The Rack.source: DGX H100 33.5 kW rack vs 12 kW traditional; 7-10 MW pod.

The Pod.teaches: The job's ~2.1 TB static state vs 640 GiB node HBM: sharding is mandatory and the optimizer term dominates; pod time then layers failure/maintenance onto the compute floor.
The Pod.source: ~12 B/param vs 8×80 GB node HBM; TP8×PP8×DP16; ~24 h compute → ~51 h maintained.

Accelerator Selection.proseOnly: The selection matrix and the 5→3→2 device count live in the precision-fit chart and the decode-floor equation.

Fallacies and Pitfalls.proseOnly: Each fallacy reuses a worked number from earlier sections.
